title: Readout from Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Rachel Reeves
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent met with UK Chancellor Reeves on April 15, 2026, discussing the U.S. Treasury's 'Economic Fury' policy targeting supporters of Iran's terrorist activities, progress of the U.S.-UK Transatlantic Taskforce for Markets of the Future, and cooperation on rare earth and critical minerals supply chains.
key_points: Secretary Bessent reaffirmed commitment to 'Economic Fury' policy using all tools against supporters of Iran's terrorist activities
U.S.-UK Transatlantic Taskforce for Markets of the Future is making progress
Both officials discussed securing supply chains for rare earths and critical minerals
